stories.headline: Jeff Dean is leaving Google to start an AI science startup
stories.blurb: The legendary Google AI executive who helped build TensorFlow and Google Brain is departing along with other top researchers to launch a new company focused on using AI to accelerate scientific discovery. The team hasn't disclosed funding details or what specific scientific problems they'll tackle first.
stories.why_it_matters: One of Google's most important AI architects just became a competitor
stories.original_headline: Jeff Dean and other top AI researchers are leaving Google to launch their own startup

stories.headline: Google Maps can now order your food and book your hotel
stories.blurb: Google Maps added AI features that let you complete transactions directly in the app—order takeout, book hotels, make reservations—without jumping to other apps or websites. The update turns Maps from a navigation tool into an assistant that can act on your behalf.
stories.why_it_matters: Google is betting you'll let one app handle errands you used to split across five.
stories.original_headline: Google Maps adds agentic features, including food ordering and hotel bookings

stories.headline: NVIDIA just shipped a reasoning model built for self-driving cars
stories.blurb: Alpamayo 2 Super is designed to handle the rare, complex driving situations that break conventional object detection—like figuring out why a cyclist is swerving or what to do when construction cones appear mid-lane. It's now available for commercial use in robotaxis and autonomous vehicles.
stories.why_it_matters: Self-driving still fails on edge cases; this targets exactly that gap with situational reasoning.
stories.original_headline: NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Super, the Frontier Open Model for Robotaxis and Autonomous Vehicles, Now Available for Commercial Use

stories.headline: Meta just open-sourced two new coding models that run locally
stories.blurb: Muse Code handles everyday programming tasks, while Muse Spark 1.2 is a tiny model designed to run on your laptop or phone without a GPU. Both are Apache 2.0 licensed. Meta says Spark beats other small models on coding benchmarks while using a fraction of the parameters.
stories.why_it_matters: You can now run a decent coding assistant entirely offline on consumer hardware.
